end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing different regional festivals, clothing and music, then finding shared ideas such as celebration, tradition, rhythm and common values. They initially described unity as people standing together, but later corrected this to shared identity and togetherness despite different languages, foods and customs. At home, ask Riya to explain one example of “many in the one” using two festivals or regional traditions.
